proof_scope: local request validation, draft preparation, fail-closed claim gating, and bounded human attestation through the real CLI; no LinkedIn network or browser access

claims.proves: the skill prepares typed local handoffs, refuses unsupported evidence-sensitive requests, and never upgrades a human attestation into platform verification; additionally: outbound actions without a permitting roundtable verdict are BLOCKED_MISSING_ROUNDTABLE, DO_NOT_SEND and NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION cannot yield an executable packet, a single PASSing seat is rejected as not a panel, sequential topology is rejected as a pipeline, a verified claim without a canonical claim_key is rejected, and profile-update is correctly exempt from the outbound gate
claims.does_not_prove: that LinkedIn accepted, displayed, sent, or delivered any action, or that an official LinkedIn API integration is authorized; it also does not prove that a roundtable actually ran — the packet records a receipt path, it does not execute the panel

stdout_contains: Automated access to LinkedIn pages or DOM content

cases.name: prepared-post-is-not-executed
command: d=$(mktemp -d); OPS_LINKEDIN_USE_SYSTEM_PYTHON=1 bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/publish-post.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; grep -E '"status": "PREPARED"|"execution_claim": "NOT_EXECUTED"|"platform_verified": false' $d/p.json

cases.name: unsupported-profile-claim-fails-closed
command: d=$(mktemp -d); OPS_LINKEDIN_USE_SYSTEM_PYTHON=1 bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/profile-update-blocked.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; rc=$?; grep BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED_CLAIMS $d/p.json; echo EXIT=$rc

cases.name: attestation-without-explicit-confirmation-is-refused
command: d=$(mktemp -d); OPS_LINKEDIN_USE_SYSTEM_PYTHON=1 bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/publish-post.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; OPS_LINKEDIN_USE_SYSTEM_PYTHON=1 bash ../run.sh attest $d/p.json --actor eval 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?

cases.name: human-attestation-never-claims-platform-proof
command: d=$(mktemp -d); OPS_LINKEDIN_USE_SYSTEM_PYTHON=1 bash ../run.sh prepare ../assets/examples/publish-post.json -o $d/p.json >/dev/null; OPS_LINKEDIN_USE_SYSTEM_PYTHON=1 bash ../run.sh attest $d/p.json --actor eval --confirm-human-completed -o $d/c.json >/dev/null; grep -E '"execution_claim": "USER_ATTESTED_MANUAL_ACTION"|"platform_verified": false' $d/c.json

cases.input: comment request whose panel returned DO_NOT_SEND
verified claim with source_refs but no claim_key
profile-update with a bound verified claim and no roundtable
